description: Linux kernel module source code for uboot environment in RAM, implementing device driver functions including read, write, ioctl, and probe for reserved memory handling.

methods.name: to_ubootenv_drvdata
methods.description: Converts file private data to ubootenv_drvdata structure.

methods.name: ubootenv_write
methods.description: Handles writing data to the uboot environment buffer.

methods.name: ubootenv_read
methods.description: Handles reading data from the uboot environment buffer.

methods.name: ubootenv_llseek
methods.description: Handles seeking within the uboot environment buffer.

methods.name: ubootenv_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for the uboot environment device.

methods.name: ubootenv_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver, maps reserved memory, and registers device.

methods.name: ubootenv_remove
methods.description: Cleans up the driver and deregisters device.
